purpose: A single, identical controlled real-substrate panel for method comparison. This is development calibration, not a paper claim or a sealed-cohort evaluation.
split: patient-disjoint support and query patients supplied by the common benchmark harness
feature_vocabulary: The identical broad benchmark feature matrix and spatial transforms produced by dbench.benchmark.run for every method.
primary_metrics: complete variable-and-transform recovery at candidate budget 16
rules: Every method is run on every same deterministic world.
Every method uses support patients only for proposal/ranking.
Held-out query patients and planted truth are evaluation-only.
No comparative result may be combined with a different panel.
